name: code_impact
description: Find what is affected by changes to a symbol. Prefer this over Glob/Grep/file reads for structural questions (symbol lookup, call chains, impact) -- the answer is pre-indexed. Scope: always the calling session's own repo -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument. Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER or E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder is missing or is not a git repository.
